text:
ravi: quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — grouping remediation actions here. main items: flaky route announcements during autoscale, restore verification gaps, and repeated deploy+scale overlap. who can own which? react with :hand: to claim.

anika: i'll take restore verification for NA and run the first drill in staging. target: automation for checksum compare + sample queries. PR in 5 days.
matt: i'll own routing validation + rollback gating. plan to add a pre-scale route-sanity job and a small canary for route withdrawals.
sre-bot: Created tickets: DR-FIX-771 (restore-verifier), NET-FIX-1190 (route-sanity), PIPE-3002 (deploy-blocker-rfc).
hana: recurring pattern note: 5 incidents show concurrent deploys during scale spikes. i propose a short deploy freeze window during autoscale spikes and a pipeline guard. i'll draft RFC.
oscar: ops update: added a "verify routes before scale" checklist entry to the runbook. link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dr-verify (needs SME review).
ravi: owners so far — anika: restore drill + automation; matt: route validation; hana: deploy-freeze RFC; oscar: runbook edits. i'll own the tracker and timeline.
anika: restore snippet i'll add to PR: ```post-restore-verify:
- sample 200 keys, compare checksum
- run read-only queries against primary
- confirm consumer lag < 30s
- emit heartbeat to ops-bot
```
matt: routing test sketch: simulate control-plane isolation for us-east, assert traffic switch <60s, and run model-fallback smoke checks. provisional game-day: Tue 13:00 UTC (2h).
hana: RFC will include pipeline check: ```if autoscale_recent_pct > 15: fail_deploy("deploy during scale spike")``` aiming to keep changes during high-churn windows blocked.
oscar: i'll coordinate reviewers and will add a post-restore hash-compare snippet to runbook. tagging @anika.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: DR-FIX-771 drill on 2026-07-02T11:00:00Z.
ravi: timeline proposal: anika PR in 5d -> matt prototype in 7d -> hana RFC in 4d -> run drill after PR merges -> schedule game-day after routing prototype validated. objections?

hana: small nit: can we make the deploy guard opt-in for emergency fixes? i'll add an exception flow in RFC.
anika: agreed, include emergency bypass with on-call approval and audit log entry.
matt: i'll add an automated smoke script that runs after any rollback and posts results to the incident channel. I'll own that.
oscar: open questions: (1) acceptance criteria for restore success? (2) who covers on-call for the game-day? please add to tracker.
ravi: suggestion for acceptance: checksum match >= 99.95% on sampled keys AND end-to-end latency within 20% baseline. put this in tracker.
anika: i'll run the first restore drill and invite platform + db eng.
ravi: i'll create the remediation tracker doc, assign the tickets from sre-bot to owners with due dates, and post a one-pager to #incidents once done. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
